record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code was not read or run. No result files are listed.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports tests of the standard raw difference-of-means recipe on Gemma-3, including ablation-related KL screening, alongside corrected estimators and causal experiments. It does not report a full reproduction of every part of the claim.
record.gate_note: The README reports outcomes for the raw recipe and corrected interventions, so these are recorded below. Pipeline descriptions, planned experiments, and method-selection criteria are not treated as results. No per-model generation rates or numerical MMLU/NLL outcomes are reported in the README.
record.test_reason: The study runs the original difference-of-means selection (bypass, induce, first-token KL < 0.1, layer < 0.8L) on Gemma-3 and other models. It reports that the raw recipe yields no usable refusal direction on Gemma-3, and it argues the original vector is dominated by a loud residual coordinate rather than refusal. The evidence is README-only: same method, arguing V1 needs restating.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The authors argue a single loud residual coordinate, not refusal, breaks the raw difference-of-means recipe on Gemma-3: 0 usable cells of 288, a failure that also reproduces on a sentiment contrast. Scale-corrected estimators restore usable cells on Gemma-3 and are a no-op on Llama/Qwen. Their ρ/√d_model and writer-gain separating statistics were fitted after seeing eight models and are not validated.
record.recipe_differences: Uses the raw difference-of-means recipe, but evaluates a grid of positions and layers with additional KL, refusal-induction, and capability criteria, and compares several corrected estimators. This GitHub repository presents experiments and code, not a replication paper; the code was not inspected or run.
record.method_sensitivity: The README reports that the raw recipe fails the KL criterion on Gemma-3; masking and standardization differ for steering; and the proposed plain-ρ threshold does not separate all reported models. It proposes ρ/√d_model and post-FFN writer gain as alternatives, but says these separating statistics were fitted after observing eight models and are not validated criteria.

fits_no_version.finding: A loud, class-blind residual coordinate (~80,000 vs ~200 units) dominates the difference-of-means vector and the projection scalar. The same failures reproduce on a sentiment contrast.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: A high-amplitude residual coordinate can distort difference-of-means estimation and projection interventions independently of safety behaviour.

fits_no_version.finding: The loud coordinate is at full amplitude in the Gemma-3-12B base checkpoint.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The loud-channel property precedes instruction tuning; this says nothing about refusal-direction transfer.

fits_no_version.finding: Directly removing the loud channel produces multi-script word salad that the repetition-based gate scores as compliance.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Zeroing the loud coordinate destroys Gemma-3 outputs, and lexical or repetition gates can misread this as refusal bypass.

fits_no_version.finding: ρ/√d_model and post-FFN writer gain separate the eight models into needs-correction vs fine. These thresholds were fitted post hoc.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Residual-scale statistics predict whether raw difference-of-means abliteration fails.

record.problems: README-only evidence; code and artifacts were not inspected or run. The README gives no numerical refusal rates, per-model results for most reported claims, or numerical MMLU/NLL outcomes. It acknowledges that its repetition-based degeneracy gate scores high-diversity word salad as compliance, and that the proposed separating statistics are not validated criteria.
record.rows_left_out: No individual model or condition rows were available for the reported multi-model threshold comparison: the README gives selected aggregate values and examples but no complete per-model results table. Planned pipeline outputs and experiments without reported outcomes were not recorded.

untested.parts: No numerical refusal or compliance rates, and no numerical MMLU/NLL, for any recipe. The induction strength of the raw direction is not reported separately from the KL failure.
No weight-edit abliteration of released models.
No multi-direction, affine or cone analysis of refusal.
The 12B base checkpoint is used only for loud-coordinate amplitude. No refusal-direction transfer across base/instruct, languages or variants is reported.
No test of training determining a removable refusal direction.

missing.what: Gemma-3-1B: 0 of 156 raw cells, median ablation KL 21 (ρ = 16).
ρ/√d_model values: 0.11, 0.12, 0.16, 0.17 for the four models where the raw recipe works vs 0.46, 0.79, 1.56, 1.73 for the four Gemma-3 sizes where it fails. Writer gain: 2.5–2.7x vs 4.5–6.9x.
On loud-channel models only the scale corrections (r1–r3) yield usable cells; masked and standardized ablation are indistinguishable; steering onset tracks 1/b.
missing.locator: README, The recipes; Pre-registered predictions items 3–4

missing.what: Llama at layer 11 has an empty mask and gain 1.000: the correction is a no-op.

record.verdict_notes: README-only evidence; no result artifacts. Only predictions 3 and 7 are explicitly marked wrong, and the third wrong prediction is not identified, so outcomes of items 1, 2, 5 and 6 are inferred. The record's r2 confuses channel removal with masked-direction ablation. The repository dates are in 2026 and the study is not peer reviewed.

versions.untested_parts: The README does not give numerical refusal/compliance rates for raw-direction ablation or addition, nor detailed capability results for the raw direction. Its corrected-estimator and channel-removal outcomes are not a full test of the original direction across every layer and position.
No reported weight-edit or released-model abliteration result.
No reported test of jailbreak suppression of the direction or training against its ablation.
The README discusses a loud coordinate and estimator corrections, but does not test whether refusal is affine, cone-shaped, or distributed across multiple refusal directions.
No separate measurement of harmfulness judgment and refusal decision.
No reported cross-language or base-to-instruct transfer test of the refusal direction.
The README reports that the loud coordinate is present in a base checkpoint, but does not test whether training determines the existence of a removable refusal direction.

rows.subject: Gemma-3

conditions.value: all raw candidates; count not stated

rows.note: The README presents this as the observed result for the raw recipe. It indicates failure of the stated KL criterion but gives no individual KL values or refusal outcome.
rows.check: The value is stated: the 02_select section says '0 usable cells out of 288' (48 layers × 6 positions) for the raw recipe on Gemma-3. No raw direction passes bypass + induce + KL, so V1's 'other abilities largely kept' fails. The quoted 'All N…' sentence is pre-registered prediction wording, not the result. Size is not tied to this count; configs list Gemma-3 1B/4B/12B/27B.

source_check.correct: Value: '0 usable cells out of 288' for the raw recipe. A usable cell must pass all of bypass + induce + KL<0.1 + layer<0.8L, so this is not KL alone. 288 = 48 layers x 6 positions, which is the gemma3-12b grid; the text does not name the model next to the 288. Also in the text: Gemma-3-1B, 0 raw cells of 156, median ablation KL 21. 'All N raw candidates rejected for KL' is the wording of pre-registered prediction 1, not a reported result. Condition: there are 288 candidates, so the count is stated. The induce rule is stricter than the original (induction on at least half the prompts, not induce_score > 0). Harmful AdvBench + SORRY-Bench against Alpaca.

statements.correction: Raw diff-of-means (r0_raw): 0 usable cells of 288. 288 = 48 layers x 6 positions, the gemma3-12b grid. Criteria: minimise refusal under ablation; induce refusal on at least half the harmless prompts (stricter than the original induce_score > 0); first-token KL < 0.1; layer < 0.8L. Gemma-3-1B: 0 raw cells of 156, median ablation KL 21. Per the README, only the scale-corrected recipes (masked, standardized, winsorized) yield usable cells on Gemma-3. The same failure reproduces on a sentiment contrast. README only; no result tables.
statements.problem: 0/288 is in the text. But the study's selection is not 'the original selection criteria': it says its induce rule is stricter than the original. Listing the study under 'no usable direction is found ... in Gemma-3' leaves out that the study reports scale-corrected estimators do yield usable cells on Gemma-3. It also attributes the raw failure to one loud coordinate, not to refusal.

statements.correction: This study: the raw recipe gives 0 usable cells of 288 (48x6 grid, gemma3-12b). Scale-corrected diff-of-means variants give usable cells on Gemma-3 and are a no-op on Llama-3-8B and Qwen-2.5-7B.
statements.problem: '0 usable cells of 288 on Gemma-3' is right for this study. The phrase 'no feasible candidate on Gemma-3-12B' does not appear in this text. If it is meant to cite this study, it is the same result counted twice. For this study, what changes the result is the estimator's scaling, not the contrast.
